brief:
The General Petroleum Authority in Gaza confirmed Thursday that four truckloads of cooking gas entered the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The authority announced the shipment through its official social media account.

Distribution to residents will proceed through unified distribution point 19/08, which serves all governorates across the strip. The authority did not specify a timeline for the rollout to civilians.
